name: GraphRAG-Benchmark
description: GraphRAG-Benchmark evaluates retrieval-augmented generation systems that leverage graph-structured knowledge sources. It measures the model's ability to retrieve relevant graph context and generate accurate, faithful answers grounded in that graph data. The benchmark focuses on factual accuracy, citation/grounding to graph nodes, and reasoning over graph relations.
evaluation_method: exact_match / factual accuracy (with possible grounding/citation checks)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face community dataset for evaluating graph-backed RAG systems; useful to researchers exploring graph-based retrieval augmentation but not yet widely adopted.
